# Captured from a live `codex exec` session, codex-cli 0.150.1, macOS 15.3.2
# arm64, 2026-08-29 (issue #463 investigation). Re-derived independently of
# the issue's own dump by running, from inside this branch's own worktree:
#
#   codex exec --sandbox workspace-write -C <worktree> \
#     "run: env | grep -Ei 'codex|plugin_root|claude' | sort"
#
# This is the whole reason the fixture is a captured file rather than a
# dict built in test code: a test that constructs its own environment can
# only fail to notice the exact way the shipped code was wrong, because it
# will happily set whatever variable the implementation expects. Only a
# real process's real environment can show that CODEX_HOME and PLUGIN_ROOT
# are never exported by Codex to a child process -- CODEX_HOME is a
# *configuration path Codex reads*, not a signature it exports.
#
# Deliberately left in (not filtered out): CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT and
# CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, because this Codex session was itself launched
# from inside a Claude Code session (nested agents), and that is the
# second, distinct defect #463 also documents -- see the
# "two signatures at once" test in tests/test_codex_signature_463.py.
CODEX_CI=1
CODEX_SANDBOX=seatbelt
CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED=1
CODEX_SESSION_ID=01a04d64-6160-73d0-b2f0-5b6a0bb09fdb
CODEX_THREAD_ID=01a04d64-6160-73d0-b2f0-5b6a0bb09fdb
CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=cli
